test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in bold in the following sentence.

He does well, though he’s sometimes **contemptuous.**
solution:
The answer is, '**humble**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Contemptuous** means **insulting, disrespectful, or mocking**.
 
• **Humble** means **respectful, or modest**.
 
 
• Example - ***Kate doesn't brag, she is humble about being at the top of her class.***
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wealthy** means **rich**.

 
 
• Example - ***Martin is a wealthy man***.
 
 
 
• **Strong** means **powerful or muscular**.
 
 
• Example -*** Wrestlers are very strong.***
 
 
 
• **Civilised** means **educated or mannered**.
 
 
• Example - ***Hayley always greets us, she is a civilized girl***.
